name: logo-com
description: Create a logo, get brand basics (colors, fonts), or make a logo for a website. Browse your LOGO.com logos and generate up to four new designs from a business name and ideas. Use when someone wants to create a logo, design a logo, make a logo, use a logo maker, get a brand mark with colors and fonts, or get a logo for their website. Requires a LOGO.com premium plan; generation uses AI credits.

interface.shortDescription: Create a logo, logo maker, brand mark, logo for website
interface.longDescription:
Create a logo and brand basics (colors, fonts), then continue on logo.com for brand kit or a website — from chat.

Connect your LOGO.com account to generate up to four new logo designs from a business name and ideas, list recent logos with previews and editor links, or open one to see its colors, fonts and download files. New designs are drafts until you open one in the LOGO.com editor and save it. After saving, brand kit and website tools are available on logo.com; this plugin covers logo creation and browsing account logos.

Natural intents: create a logo, design a logo, make a logo, logo maker, brand mark, logo colors and fonts, logo for my business, logo for my website.

Requirements: a LOGO.com premium plan. Creating designs uses your account's AI credits.
defaultPrompt: Create a logo for my coffee shop, Bean There
Design a brand logo for my startup and show colors and fonts
I need a logo for my new website — design a few options

positive.description: List saved logos. Setup: the connected premium account has at least one saved sample logo in its selected organization. Only logos owned by that user in that organization are eligible. Run in a fresh conversation.
positive.prompt: Show me my most recent saved logos, with previews and links to open them.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_logos with no arguments. Show the returned business names, previews, and editor links for at most 50 logos in the returned order. Do not create designs or claim access to another user's logos. If has_more is true, explain that this is a limited recent list rather than inventing a next page.

positive.description: Inspect a saved logo's brand details. Setup: the newest saved sample logo has known colors and fonts that can be compared with the LOGO.com editor. Run in a fresh conversation with the premium account connected.
positive.prompt: What colors and fonts does my most recent saved logo use? Include a link to open that logo.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_logos, then get_logo with the first returned logo_id. Report only colors and font details present in get_logo's response, and use its editor_url. The details must match the selected sample logo. Do not infer missing fonts or generate a replacement logo.

positive.description: Retrieve downloads for an existing logo. Setup: the newest saved sample logo supports high-resolution PNG, transparent PNG, SVG, and PDF downloads. Run in a fresh conversation with the premium account connected.
positive.prompt: Give me download links for my most recent saved logo as a high-resolution PNG, transparent PNG, SVG, and PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the most recent logo through list_logos and pass its logo_id to get_logo. Present the four requested downloads using the returned files' names, formats, and URLs. Open the links during review and verify they return the selected logo in the stated format. Do not invent URLs or substitute another logo; report any missing format as unavailable.

positive.description: Create one draft from a detailed brief. Setup: the connected premium account can create designs, has sufficient AI credits, and has no generation already running. This case consumes AI credits. Run in a fresh conversation and wait for completion before the next generation case.
positive.prompt: Create one minimal logo for my bakery, Rise & Crumb, with the slogan Baked daily, color #D97706, and a wheat-stalk icon. Show me the preview and a link to edit it.
positive.expected_behavior: Call generate_logos once for one design, passing the business name Rise & Crumb, the slogan Baked daily, a minimal style, the color #D97706 and a wheat-stalk icon idea from the prompt. If the job is pending, poll get_logo_generation with the returned job instead of starting another generation. On success, return exactly one design's preview and editor link, and explain that it is a draft until saved in the editor. Treat the brief as guidance rather than guaranteeing exact artwork. If the job is partial or failed, report the actual status; do not claim success or automatically start paid replacement work.

positive.description: Create the maximum supported batch and follow asynchronous progress. Setup: the connected premium account can create designs, has enough AI credits for four designs and preparation, and has no generation already running. This case consumes AI credits. Run in a fresh conversation after the previous generation finishes.
positive.prompt: Create four playful logo options for Northstar Cycling, a bicycle repair shop. Use navy #16324F and orange #F18F01, with a bicycle-wheel icon. Show all four previews and editor links when they are ready.
positive.expected_behavior: Make one generate_logos call for four designs, passing the business name Northstar Cycling, a bicycle repair shop industry, a playful style, the colors #16324F and #F18F01 and a bicycle-wheel icon idea from the prompt. While pending, poll the same job with get_logo_generation and keep the user informed without starting duplicate generations. On success, show four previews with matching editor links and explain that they are unsaved drafts. If the job is partial or failed, show only the designs that completed and explain the failures. Never invent results or automatically charge for a retry.

negative.description: Non-logo image request. Expected behavior: no LOGO.com tool is called, because LOGO.com only creates logos. The host may answer with its own capabilities or explain the limit, but must not turn the request into a LOGO.com logo-generation job.
negative.prompt: Create a photorealistic picture of a golden retriever surfing, with no text or branding.

negative.description: Another company's existing logo. Expected behavior: no LOGO.com tool is called, because LOGO.com can only access the connected user's own saved logos. The host may answer with its own capabilities, but must not pass a guessed logo_id or present a LOGO.com result as another company's official asset.
negative.prompt: Find Nike's official logo and give me its original SVG file.

negative.description: Unsupported purchase or subscription change. Expected behavior: explain that this plugin cannot upgrade subscriptions or purchase credits. Do not call LOGO.com tools, initiate checkout, supply a transactional link, or claim a purchase succeeded.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my LOGO.com subscription and buy more AI credits for me.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products, start subscriptions, purchase credits, or process payments. It lets users access features included in an existing LOGO.com premium account. Logo generation consumes the account's existing AI credits.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of the LOGO.com plugin for ChatGPT and Codex. Connect an existing premium account to browse saved logos, inspect colors and fonts, retrieve available download links, and generate one to four draft logo designs with previews and editor links. Generation uses existing AI credits. Designs are saved only when the user saves them in the LOGO.com editor.
